about: Table of contents derived from concept-map/concepts.json. One book: chapters numbered 1..N, each made of sections; each section is one concept home (one page). Appendices follow: A is a curated links appendix whose pages (A.1, A.2, ...) hold concepts but are not built as text; B is a reading page with no concepts. Chapters with first_pass true are the first build pass. Section tier is the most common tier of its concepts (ties go to the more basic tier).

sections.title: Amortized analysis
sections.notes: Reference link (References item, link only): jeffe-notes:09-amortize.3, Erickson's lecture notes on incrementing and decrementing counters (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). The concept counter-increment-decrement was removed from the map by ruling 19 (METHOD §4.4): it had no open prose and contest tier; its inventory row is listed under dropped in concepts.json.

appendices.title: Computer systems
appendices.note: Curated links appendix: each page lists the reader-facing links for its concepts, no text is written for it. The concepts stay in the concept map so prerequisite edges into them resolve; a book concept that rests on one points the reader to its page. Pages are grouped by the former chapters (group ids), which are not numbered book chapters.
